nodes.label: Search Icon (Magnifying Glass)
nodes.description: A magnifying glass icon used in the E-Tipitaka UI to represent the search action. Visually, a circular lens with a diagonal handle. Represents the search/find functionality in the application.

nodes.label: Search Action
nodes.rationale: The magnifying glass is a universal UI metaphor for search. Used in the E-Tipitaka application to allow users to query Tipitaka scriptures.
